wesley-dashboard-builder 1.0.0 – Initial release with full web dashboard generation and deployment workflow.

- Step-by-step instructions provided for dashboard creation, API integration, media usage, and deployment.
- Includes detailed checklists to ensure quality and functionality before delivery.
